scene1: At the dawn of the Khmer Empire, golden spires rose to touch the heavens...
scene2: A vision of divine kingship united the realm, anchored in compassion and care.
scene3: Across the empire, over one hundred hospitals offered sanctuary, medicine, and healing.
scene4: Dedicated healers tended to every citizen, viewing service to the sick as service to the divine.
scene5: An intricate royal highway and communication network connected distant provinces into one beating heart.
scene6: Their eternal legacy endures in stone, spirit, and timeless compassion.
